title: Renewal activation map + action sheet (Apr 2026)
content:
Sheet: Renewal Activation Map (working)

Columns:
Account | CS Owner | ARR ($) | Renewal Date | Contract Term | Renewal Window Start | Days until Renewal | Engagement Score (0-100) | Exec Sponsor Confirmed | Renewal Probability (%) | Weighted ARR ($) | Next Action | Next Action Owner | Action Due | Last Touchpoint (date) | Primary Risk(s) | Playbook Step | Notes / Conversation snippets

Notes on columns: Engagement Score is a composite quick-metric (usage + QBR attendance + support volume). Weighted ARR = ARR * Renewal Probability. Renewal Probability is an assessed value (not a system probability) with reason in Notes. Playbook Step refers to the CS playbook micro-step (e.g., re-engage, commercial-opportunity, executive-brief).

Rows (examples):
1) AeroMetrics | CS: Marco Liu | 420,000 | 2026-06-18 | Annual | 2026-05-18 | 69 | 78 | Yes | 78 | 327,600 | Schedule exec briefing + contract review | Marco Liu | 2026-04-20 | 2026-03-25 | Renew-As-Is risk: moderate pricing sensitivity; requested ROI summary; exec sponsor exists | Exec align & pricing prep | Customer asked for model-latency savings case; finance reviewing.

2) BrightLane AI | CS: Sophie Carter | 120,000 | 2026-05-03 | 12 months | 2026-04-03 | 21 | 42 | No | 35 | 42,000 | Product health check + deployment checklist | Sophie Carter | 2026-03-30 | 2026-03-10 | Low usage in some products; stalled PoC; commercial pressure | Re-activate + usage campaign | Offer 60-day technical uplift; introduce Solutions AE.

3) Continental Health Sys | CS: Benji Ortega | 1,050,000 | 2026-09-30 | 24 months | 2026-08-30 | 139 | 86 | Yes | 92 | 966,000 | Legal + procurement pre-read; confirm KBA | Benji Ortega | 2026-04-28 | 2026-04-02 | Compliance review on premises deployment; procurement lead on holiday | Legal handoff & enterprise playbook | Private deployment PoC approved, expecting signature.

4) Doorframe Studios | CS: Elena Morales | 38,500 | 2026-04-20 | Monthly | 2026-03-21 | -1 | 30 | No | 10 | 3,850 | Outreach for churn prevention | Elena Morales | 2026-03-15 | 2026-03-01 | Churn risk: low engagement, competitor discounting | Churn-save play | Conversation went quiet after demo; send survival checklist.

5) EdgeOps Inc | CS: Aisha Patel | 275,000 | 2026-07-12 | Annual | 2026-06-12 | 91 | 64 | Partial | 60 | 165,000 | Run cost optimization review + quantization pilot | Aisha Patel | 2026-04-25 | 2026-03-30 | Concern over token costs; interested in quantized variants | Cost reduction playbook | Engineering asked for benchmarks; connect to Optimize team.

6) FinSight Partners | CS: Marco Liu | 600,000 | 2026-10-05 | 12 months | 2026-09-05 | 174 | 49 | No | 45 | 270,000 | Renew proposal + commercial sweetener | Marco Liu | 2026-05-10 | 2026-03-20 | Procurement slow, needs SOC2 addendum | Commercial uplift play | Offer 10% for 12-month commit; follow-up legal.

7) Gigsync | CS: Sophie Carter | 78,000 | 2026-05-28 | 12 months | 2026-04-28 | 46 | 55 | No | 55 | 42,900 | Demo new batching quant option | Sophie Carter | 2026-04-05 | 2026-02-15 | Eng usage spikes but cost sensitivity | Product-driven retention play | Feature brief scheduled; product manager invited.

8) Horizon Retail | CS: Benji Ortega | 210,000 | 2026-08-02 | 24 months | 2026-07-02 | 112 | 72 | Yes | 80 | 168,000 | Contract amendment draft for multi-region | Benji Ortega | 2026-05-01 | 2026-03-28 | Data residency question in EU region | Private deployment clause; legal check | Ops asked for data flow diagram.

9) Insightverse | CS: Elena Morales | 52,000 | 2026-06-14 | Annual | 2026-05-14 | 62 | 25 | No | 20 | 10,400 | Usage workshop + roadmap tie-in | Elena Morales | 2026-04-08 | 2026-03-02 | Low strategic priority; competitor courting | Low-touch re-engage play | Offer tutorial + 1:1 onboarding slot.\n
10) Juno Analytics | CS: Aisha Patel | 160,000 | 2026-12-01 | 12 months | 2026-11-01 | 232 | 90 | Yes | 95 | 152,000 | Executive renewal prep + CFO alignment | Aisha Patel | 2026-05-15 | 2026-04-03 | Strong usage and exec sponsor; may expand scope | Expansion sale play | Prepare 1-year extension with new modules.

Formulas / quick cells (textual for this sheet):
- Days until Renewal = (Renewal Date - TODAY()) expressed in days.
- Weighted ARR = ARR * (Renewal Probability / 100)  (used for simple forecasting).
- Priority flag: High if Days until Renewal <= 60 and Renewal Probability < 70 OR Engagement Score < 40 and ARR > 100k.

Quick playbook micro-steps (shorthand):
- Exec align: schedule executive briefing, send two-pager ROI with 3 case studies, include legal pre-read.
- Cost reduction play: run Optimize cost-review, propose quantized variant, estimate monthly token savings.
- Churn-save: targeted usage campaign, 1:1 onboarding, 30-day check-ins.
- Legal handoff: attach SOC2/KBA, timeline for procurement, identify legal reviewer.

Action guidance (who to ping):
- Marco: focus on AeroMetrics, FinSight (high ARR impact).
- Sophie: Gigsync, BrightLane (usage reactivation).
- Benji: Continental Health, Horizon Retail (enterprise legal/procurement).
- Elena: Insightverse, Doorframe (low-touch churn saves).
- Aisha: EdgeOps, Juno (cost & expansion).

Next steps for this doc:
- Convert to canonical QBR worksheet tab: move 'playbook step' to linked playbook page and add checkboxes per action.
- Sync with Renewals AE on commercial offers before next update (target: weekly cadence).
- Add column: 'Commercial Offer' and 'Offer Expiry' in next revision.

Unresolved / Open questions:
- Do we standardize Renewal Probability bands (e.g., 0-30 = red, 31-60 = amber, 61-100 = green)? Recommend yes.
- Should we compute a 90-day forecast separately using only accounts with Renewal Window Start within 90 days? (proposed)
- Confirm if Weighted ARR should apply discount factors for multi-year deals.

Change log (working):
- 2026-04-09: initial draft created by Aisha.
- 2026-04-10: added engagement scoring rule and priority flag.
- 2026-04-12: added example rows and action owners; flagged legal handoffs.

Document intent: Working tracker for CS team to prioritize renewal motions and track evidence for probability assessments. This is intentionally informal — migrate finalized rows into the standard renewal pipeline sheet when resolved.
summary: Total ARR in sample rows: $2,986,500; Total Weighted ARR (sample): $2,182,750; High-priority accounts (by flag): AeroMetrics, BrightLane, Doorframe, EdgeOps (4). Recommendation: weekly sync, add commercial offer column, standardize probability bands.
